recipe.visualDefinition: A high-contrast, candid portrait of a male performer in a joyful, expressive pose, set against a flat, saturated blue background. The subject wears a highly detailed paisley shirt and layered necklaces, with large-scale, thin sans-serif typography overlapping the upper portion of the frame.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject's expressive face balanced by large-scale geometric type
Intricate paisley pattern contrasting with flat monochromatic background
Warm skin tones and shirt colors against cool cyan-blue field
Tight cropping creating a sense of intimacy and energy

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Subject is positioned in the lower right two-thirds, cropped at the waist and shoulders, leaning into the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's face and open-mouthed smile serve as the primary focal point.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes start at the large white text at the top, move down to the subject's face, and follow the gesture of the hands.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Large open blue area in the upper left allows the typography to breathe.

colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Warm Earth Tones (Orange, Red, Tan in shirt and skin)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the background with naturalistic, warm values in the subject.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single font family used in two colors (White and Yellow) to differentiate hierarchy.
graphicDevices: Small metadata text at the very top center
Small circular logo/catalog number in the top right corner

candidateDirections.nameOrCategory: ITC Avant Garde Gothic Extra Light

candidateDirections.reason: Classic geometric proportions similar to the era.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: A candid medium shot of a man with a joyful expression, eyes closed, wearing a vibrant orange and green paisley shirt and beaded necklaces. He is set against a solid, flat cyan-blue background. The lighting is bright and even, typical of 1960s studio photography.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add two lines of large, thin, white and pale yellow geometric sans-serif text in the upper left quadrant. The text should be tightly tracked and slightly overlap the subject's head. Add small 'STEREO' text in yellow at the top center.

verificationChecks: Is the background a solid, vibrant blue?
Is the typography ultra-thin and geometric?
Does the subject's shirt feature a complex paisley pattern?
Is the expression joyful and candid?

mustRedesign: Specific artist name and album title
postGenerationChecks: Ensure text is legible despite the thin weight
Check that the paisley pattern does not look AI-distorted
Verify the blue background is flat and lacks distracting elements
Confirm the subject's expression feels authentic and not posed
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine a high-energy candid portrait in patterned clothing with a flat primary-color background and oversized, hairline-weight geometric sans-serif type.
